caption:
Ctrl+F Wayfair filings: "focused" (8/4) · "reduction" (8/19)

We searched two of Wayfair's own filings, 15 days apart.

“we remain squarely focused on our customers and our suppliers, and on making sure Wayfair is their preferred platform for the Home.” (Q2 2022 results release, Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1, filed Aug 4, 2022)
https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1616707/000161670722000105/a2022-06x30exhibit991.htm

“announced a workforce reduction involving approximately 870 employees” (Form 8-K, Item 2.05, filed Aug 19, 2022)
https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1616707/000161670722000121/w-20220819.htm

From two Aug 2022 filings.

Our math: $3,284,000,000 ÷ 870 = $3,774,712 (about $3.7 million, rounded down). The $3,284 million is Wayfair's total net revenue for the second quarter of 2022; the same release reports a $378 million net loss. The 870 are employees in the workforce reduction the 8-K describes.

alt: Vertical video, about 25 seconds, with a synthetic voice and subtitles that light up word by word. A white page of Wayfair's Q2 2022 results release, Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1 dated Aug 4, 2022 is shown with a search bar called Find in filing: the word "focused" is typed and one line is highlighted in yellow (1 of 1). A hard cut to a page of Wayfair's Form 8-K, Item 2.05 dated Aug 19, 2022: "reduction" is typed and a line is highlighted (1 of 6). The two highlighted lines are stacked with the text 15 days apart. A black card follows and shows $3,284 MILLION (total net revenue, q2 2022), ABOUT 870 and ABOUT $3.7 MILLION q2 2022 revenue per employee in the reduction, and a closing card reads Our take: Focused. Reduction. Wayfair's own words. We only searched.
